Documents.Title: Planning Robby's routes
Documents.Text: NavigationService plans Robby's routes between inspection waypoints. Each route has a route ID and uses the current position estimate. These are fictional teaching facts, not physical control instructions.

Documents.Title: Wheel calibration records
Documents.Text: MotorService stores Robby's wheel calibration records. In this fictional teaching policy, a calibration record expires after seven days. An expired record requires a technician review before a simulated mission is approved.

Documents.Title: Reviewing simulated hazard reports
Documents.Text: SafetyService reviews Robby's simulated hazard reports. A suspicious smoke reading marks the simulated mission for human review. This teaching workflow does not certify safety, detect real fires, or operate hardware.

Documents.Title: Delivery of diagnostic messages
Documents.Text: TelemetryService delivers Robby's diagnostic messages to the teaching dashboard. Failed deliveries are retried three times in this fictional policy. Undelivered messages remain in the demonstration queue.

Documents.Title: Scheduling inspection missions
Documents.Text: MissionService lists Robby's simulated inspection missions by zone and planned date. Each mission references a map revision and a set of inspection waypoints. This catalog does not dispatch the robot car.

Documents.Title: Position estimates and map revisions
Documents.Text: LocalizationService stores Robby's position estimate with a timestamp and map revision. In the fictional teaching policy, estimates older than thirty seconds are marked stale for review. This is not a real navigation tolerance.

Documents.Title: Technician access to the dashboard
Documents.Text: IdentityService verifies the technician's identity before access to Robby's teaching dashboard. Account recovery restores dashboard access after a forgotten password. Dashboard access does not grant permission to control hardware.

Documents.Title: Preparing maintenance reviews
Documents.Text: MaintenanceService prepares Robby's maintenance review using a route ID and a technician identity. A technician can request a route inspection or record a completed review. These teaching records do not perform repairs.
